greetings_help: Single text e.g. "Hello", or time-based split by semicolon: "Good morning;Good noon;Good afternoon;Good evening"
weather_location_help: For API: use city name for municipalities (e.g. Beijing), or full region (e.g. Ontario Toronto).
weather_offline_help: To use weather, turn off offline mode and enable weather above.
weather_enable_help: To use weather, please enable weather above.

about_desc_1: Lightweight, fast, beautiful start page for HomeLab or privacy-focused use.
about_desc_2: No database. Your data is open and 100% yours.
clock_preview_error: Cannot preview: use a valid IANA zone; configure TZ explicitly for an opaque server Local zone.
clock_help: Live updates use the visitor device clock, without network time synchronization. Device time zone requires JavaScript; without scripts the server-rendered time remains. Preview refreshes when options change.
clock_noscript: Device time zone requires JavaScript; showing server-rendered time.
mobile_bookmark_help: Compact columns read from top to bottom, then left to right. Screens narrower than 360 CSS pixels use one column. This does not change saved category order.
readability_help: Navigation text and application descriptions apply to the homepage, bookmarks and applications pages. Greeting size applies to the homepage. Device text scaling still applies.
category_navigation_help: Search expands matching groups. Category selection changes presentation only.
desktop_columns_help: Applies above 768px. The requested count is a maximum; fewer columns are used to keep entries readable.
search_mode_hybrid: Local suggestions, Enter to search the web
search_new_tab_help: Adds a new-tab search action. In the first two modes, web searches also open in a new tab by default; local filtering stays on this page.
search_keywords_help: Use !g query for an engine keyword, or !local query for bookmarks. Unknown keywords remain ordinary search text.
search_template_help: Use an absolute HTTP(S) URL with exactly one {query} inside a query parameter value. Searches are sent only when submitted.
search_save_help: Adding, removing and moving rows changes this form only. Save changes to apply them. Test opens the engine with “Flare search test” without saving.
search_test_target: Test sends a query to this configured address:
search_no_results: No matching bookmarks or applications. Click a web engine to continue.

search_mode_local_first: Local first, web search on demand
search_mode_select_help: Choose bookmarks and apps or a web engine. Enter searches the selected target.
search_mode_hybrid_help: Typing shows local matches. Enter searches the selected web engine. Click a local match or select it with arrow keys and Enter. Requires an enabled external default engine.
search_mode_local_first_help: Typing shows local matches. Enter filters bookmarks and apps. After submitting, click an engine to search the web. No automatic redirect.
search_default_help: The first mode requires a web engine. Local first always starts locally. Manual selection starts with this default target.
search_hybrid_hint: Type to find bookmarks and apps. Press Enter to search the web.
search_auto_focus: Focus search when opening the page
search_compatibility: Legacy search settings are supported without enabling external engines. Existing local search and engine data are retained. The original file stays unchanged until you save; changed settings are backed up before saving. The first upgrade backup is kept permanently; later changes retain one latest backup.
search_engine_required: Add and enable a web engine before using Enter to search the web.
search_version_downgrade: This configuration belongs to a newer application version. Saving is blocked to protect its data. Use that version or a newer release.
